UCI Online Retail, sampled: attribution
=======================================

`online_retail_sample.csv.gz` and `online_retail_small.csv.gz` hold lines of the UCI Online Retail dataset, chosen by
customer with a fixed seed by `make_fixture.py` (see it for exactly how). The lines are as the dataset has them.

Dataset      Online Retail (541,909 invoice lines, 8 columns, 2010-12-01 to 2011-12-09)
Upstream     https://archive.ics.uci.edu/dataset/352/online+retail
Licence      Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0), https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
Credit       Chen, D. (2015). Online Retail [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository.
             https://doi.org/10.24432/C5BW33
Changes      Only a sample of the lines is kept (by customer), as described above; no cell is altered.
Copy used    https://raw.githubusercontent.com/databricks/Spark-The-Definitive-Guide/master/data/retail-data/all/online-retail-dataset.csv
             (the same 541,909 data rows and 8 columns; `make_fixture.py` refuses a file that is not)

The licence record for the whole repository's use of this dataset, with the paper to cite and what was not verified, is
`library/online-retail/LICENSE.txt`.
